reviews.text: Naysa has been taking care of our dog for year now, and she is such a wonderful person with huge love for animals. Our dog is anxious and has food sensitivity and she always goes above and beyond to make his stays comfortable and keep him as happy as possible while he is away from home! ❤️ we are looking forward to seeing her again 🐾

I can’t recommend Naysa’s cat sitting enough. She is exceptionally trustworthy, professional, and genuinely cares about your pets like they're her own. Leaving your furry friends behind can be stressful, but Naysa gives you complete peace of mind! Thank you! 😊

I can only say great things about Naysa! She's absolutely incredible with my Ziggy. Every single time she cares for Ziggy, I have total peace of mind knowing she’s in the best hands. Ziggy is always so super to see her, which tells me everything I need to know. Reliable, caring, and truly awesome—thank you for taking such amazing care of my fluffy girl!

Our dog Murphy stayed with Naysa for 15 days. It was simply great! He had never before stayed in a place that he felt so comfortable and happy as he did with her. He came home happy,  and it was clear to us that he had an amazing time. That's for sure our choice for the next time.

Every time we leave our little dog with her, we do it with complete peace of mind. She is extremely professional, and our dog absolutely loves her. I’ve been trusting Naysa for three years now, and I never hesitate to reach out to her whenever I need a pet sitter. It’s clear that she truly loves animals and always makes sure our dog is cared for and feels just as comfortable and happy as she does at home ❤️

Naysa is the most amazing and caring pet sitter for our dog, Charlie. Not only does she provide lots of updates and pictures, but she treats Charlie as if he is her own dog with so much care and affection. She’s also very thoughtful and experienced about his unique behavior and needs given his reactive nature. Whenever we arrive in Naysa’s neighborhood, Charlie can’t get to her door soon enough, he’s always so excited to see his favorite “Auntie”.
Our dog Lilly had the time of her life here and loves coming back. Naysa, thanks for the good care and loving attention!

Naysa was great with our cat Mina, she gave her all the care and attention she needed while we were on vacation while at the same time keeping us updated during her visits with pictures and videos.
